reminder.notes:
Safer reminder deletion with an undo window

Deleting a reminder no longer removes it the moment you tap Delete. After the
confirmation, the reminder disappears from your lists but is held for five
seconds behind an Undo bar that counts down, and only then is it really
deleted. Undo puts it straight back, and nothing was ever written to the
database in between.

Repeating reminders now ask what you actually want to remove: just the next
occurrence, which is skipped so the series keeps running, or the whole
reminder. The choice shows the exact date and time that would be skipped.

### Features

- Five-second undo window on every delete path: swipe, the long-press menu,
  the Done list, and the Disabled list.
- Repeating reminders ask "this occurrence only" versus "all occurrences",
  with the next fire time named in the dialog.
- Skipping one occurrence takes the same path a Dismiss takes when the alarm
  rings, so the skip replicates to the account's other devices.
- Deletes and skips are recorded in the diagnostics log (identifiers only, no
  reminder text), so a reminder that disappears can be traced.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.

ai-scanner.notes:
AI Scanner 1.4.1 — Background update checks, and no more double-downloading updates

### Features
- AI Scanner now checks for updates periodically in the background (about every 6 hours) and posts a notification when one is found, in addition to the existing manual "Check for Updates" in Settings. Tapping the notification opens the app; the download and install still happen from the Settings sheet.

### Bug fixes
- The update downloader now persists its in-flight DownloadManager id and re-attaches to a still-running download instead of deleting the partial file and starting over — fixes re-downloading the same update from zero after backgrounding or reopening the app mid-update.
- The update sheet now re-syncs its progress on resume instead of occasionally showing a frozen progress bar.

mirrordrive.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

- The Settings screen now shows the installed app version and a PNSJY brand footer as its
  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
